sections.heading: Objective
sections.rationale: Generic, unassessable objective replaced by two observable ones.

sections.heading: Teacher Explanation
sections.rationale: Describes how to teach without teaching; replaced by short read-aloud explanations.

sections.heading: Worked Examples or Demonstrations
sections.rationale: Placeholder ('Model a short scenario…'); replaced by the ball-and-road scenario.

sections.heading: Guided Practice
sections.rationale: Placeholder; replaced by right-or-duty items and misconception checks.

sections.heading: Independent Practice
sections.rationale: Placeholder that asked Grade 1 learners to write; replaced by choices and spoken answers recorded by the teacher.

sections.heading: Assessment Questions
sections.rationale: Placeholder; replaced by teacher-recorded performance tasks with rubrics.

sections.heading: Remediation Support
sections.rationale: Generic remediation replaced by prerequisite diagnostics with fallback routes.

sections.heading: Extension or Challenge
sections.rationale: Replaced by the optional invent-a-rule extension.

sections.heading: Guardian Support
sections.rationale: Home conversation idea kept for teacher and guardian notes.

sections.heading: Real-World Application
sections.rationale: The abstract 'connect to community participation' note is replaced by the concrete ball-and-road story.

sections.heading: Materials and Activity Notes
sections.rationale: Teacher-facing materials note; picture cards added for the performance task.

sections.heading: Additional Teacher Notes
sections.rationale: A word-for-word duplicate of the previous section.
